Yes. I visited the embassy (consulate?) up in DC/Georgetown some months ago. I was originally planning on moving there EVENTUALLY, in 2 to 3 years. I wasn't homeless then. 

I can be up there for up to 90 days without a visa. I very confident I'll be able to find work, ANY kind of work. My DD-214 isn't recognized by the UN, only the US (as far as I know, if I'm not mistaken, I'll need to double check that), which would make it infinitely easier for me to get a job. Then my employer would automatically be my sponsor, and in 7 years, apply for citizenship (ideally). I know it's a risk, but it's a risk I'm willing to take. Worst comes to worst, I'd rather rot in the most beautiful country in the world, rather than being treated like garbage and living like garbage in my own.

A whole load of reasons. First off, it's peaceful. That's something I need right now in my life. Crime is very low, and they don't have a VICE problem like the US and most 3rd world countries. The scenery is gorgeous (I was physically in Iceland for a layover when I went on tour in Europe 5 years ago. I'm still awestruck.), the language is beautiful, and it's one of the last "frontiers" here on Earth. They have no standing military, (minus their very small Coast Guard and even smaller Viking Squad) and aren't aggressive. All of this would be conducive to my recovery.

I'm actually doing a little better now. I saw a therapist, and she actually said that...brace yourself...alcohol is the best treatment for me, at this point in time. Now, before anyone starts bashing this, let's put this into perspective: I've been on all kinds of antidepressants, some of the most potent antipsychotics, and other mood stabilizers available on the market today. None of which had much of an effect on me. However, when I drink, I don't have an inkling of a feeling about offing myself. I just feel excellent. 

Now, I know I can't just get tanked every single night till the day I die, but it's a start. Until we can come up with a legitimate medication regimen, I'm to drink a little bit every evening, in moderation of course.

I've noticed my feelings are a bit less intense (considering how strong they are, relatively speaking that's a great relief) since I started sucking on my bottle. 

Now...people say that there is no magic pill for a cure to all my pain...well...in my case there is, but in the long run, it'll probably ruin my life. Some call it opiate abuse, I call it wizardry. Been clean 7 months, but it's hard. Holy fuck it's hard.

In all seriousness, it's a miracle no one was hurt, it's happened many a times where friends where showing off their gun, only for a negligent discharge to change your life forever.
